tests/recon_all/test_process_memory_name.test_scope: mocked PID aliases and visibility; no actual accelerator-b host-to-container mapping test

tests/recon_all/test_nvml_process_memory.test_scope: mocked driver data, device selection, fallback and unavailable memory

limits: The public summary has no resolved tree peak; current observations do not retroactively identify historical GPU processes.
The target compute-process sum and whole-device peak have different scopes and need not occur at the same time; they must not be added or substituted for the FNIT process-tree peak.

current_environment_observation.package_scope_limit: The base environment check does not determine availability in independently installed FNIT targets. Switching between NVML and nvidia-smi does not itself provide a PID namespace mapping.

current_raw_ga_v2_observation.scope: A single live process identity and target-GPU numeric observation; not a peak measurement or a new reconstruction run.

findings.summary: Current accelerator-b proc metadata has no NSpid or readable complete host proc view. Existing code therefore has only local numeric PID aliases while GPU queries expose an unmatched driver PID.

The unconditional local-PID identity aliases and /proc/<driver_pid> existence test do not prove equal driver and container PID namespaces. A numeric collision could classify an unrelated driver process as own or external.

add_worker currently records metadata only; the sampled tree is rebuilt from the parent's live children. Reparented descendants and PID reuse need separate lifetime identity handling if that scope is required.

minimum_proposed_changes_not_implemented: Record kernel, PID namespace evidence, NSpid availability and mapping-unavailable reason without altering historical results.
Treat numeric PID identity as unverified when driver/proc namespace equality is not established; do not use local /proc visibility alone as host PID ownership proof.
If future infrastructure supplies a trusted host PID map or authorized host proc view, bind host/local PID, namespace, same UID and starttime to prevent PID reuse; otherwise retain null ownership.
Add meaningful namespace-collision, missing-NSpid and PID-reuse contracts if implementing the mapping change; existing mock alias tests alone do not establish a real accelerator-b mapping.

public_export.source_scope: old unmodified profiling module and live allowed identity observations; not new repaired-source runtime
